primary_question: Common-variant COPD susceptibility versus non-COPD controls.

within_case_design: no; this accession tests COPD versus non-COPD controls
smoking_design: Bergen cases/controls >=2.5 pack-years; all discovery/replication current/former smokers. Main associations adjust exposure; secondary interactions were separately tested.
sex_design: Both sexes; NAS control component is male where present.

full_stats_status: not_available_in_frozen_Catalog; public full file not verified; this is availability, not a negative association
uncertainties: Participant-level overlap cannot be deduplicated; exact numbers shared between publications are not_reported.
source_evidence: Methods specifies spirometric case/control thresholds and smoking minimum; staged replication uses ICGN and NETT/NAS.

control_definition: Bergen: post-BD FEV1>80% predicted and FEV1/FVC>0.7; normal-smoking controls.
overlap_notes: GenKOLS, NETT/NAS and ICGN reused in subsequent Cho/Hobbs/Sakornsakolpat studies; cohort labels do not imply independent replication.
rationale: Direct spirometric susceptibility. Secondary smoking interactions do not change the main accession estimand.

primary_question: Genetic association with longitudinal FEV1 decline among mild-to-moderate COPD participants.
copd_modeled_outcome: no; repeated lung-function trajectory within COPD
ascertainment: Lung Health Study annual spirometry over five years.
spirometry: Annual visits 1-5; outcome is longitudinal FEV1 decline, not binary obstruction.
clinical_diagnosis: Mild COPD recruitment; separate clinical adjudication not_reported.
smoking_design: Current smokers at LHS enrollment; smoking intensity and cessation/re-initiation modeled longitudinally.
discovery_replication: LHS discovery; CHS/FHS/BLSA/NELSON and ECLIPSE attempted replication. Replication was negative, not unavailable.
full_stats_status: not_available_in_frozen_Catalog; public full file not verified; this is availability, not a negative association
uncertainties: Participant-level overlap cannot be deduplicated; exact numbers shared between publications are not_reported.
source_evidence: Methods uses generalized estimating equations for five-year decline; paper reports unsuccessful replication.
case_definition: LHS participants with mild COPD; 4,048 European-American participants in analysis.
control_definition: not_applicable; no unaffected case-control comparison for the primary GWAS
overlap_notes: ECLIPSE and general-population replication cohorts overlap some later COPD consortium analyses; discovery LHS differs from classic case-control discovery.
rationale: Directly observed longitudinal decline does not satisfy the susceptibility case-control estimand.

primary_question: COPD without chronic bronchitis versus normal-spirometry smokers; a secondary susceptibility contrast in a subtype paper.
spirometry: Required; case and control definitions below.
clinical_diagnosis: Spirometric case definition; separate clinical adjudication not_reported.
severity_selected: yes; at least moderate airflow limitation
within_case_design: no; this accession tests COPD versus non-COPD controls
subtype_secondary_phenotype: Cases exclude chronic bronchitis; CB means productive cough >=3 months in each of two consecutive years. Separate within-COPD CB test is not this accession.
smoking_design: Current/former smokers; smoking covariate adjustment; accession is a susceptibility effect, not an interaction coefficient.
discovery_replication: Three-cohort meta-analysis; no separate replication cohort reported for this contrast.
full_stats_status: not_available_in_frozen_Catalog; public full file not verified; this is availability, not a negative association
uncertainties: Supplement Table S8 PDF itself not retrieved; classification triangulates main-text contrast, sample count and Catalog locus pattern. No evidence of a mixed estimand within the accession.
source_evidence: Methods/results specify a no-CB COPD versus smoker-control analysis; Table 3 totals 3,777 no-CB participants; supplement Table S8 describes its associations.
case_definition: 3,777 COPD subjects WITHOUT CB; post-BD FEV1/FVC<0.7 and FEV1<80% predicted.
control_definition: 3,520 current/former smokers with post-BD FEV1/FVC>=0.7 and FEV1>=80% predicted.
overlap_notes: Subsets of cohorts already used in susceptibility GWAS; not independent replication.
rationale: Catalog's 3,777 cases match the no-CB case group and FAM13A/HHIP/IREB2 results of Supplement Table S8, not 1,662 CB cases or within-case contrast.

primary_question: Common-variant COPD susceptibility versus non-COPD controls.
